source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Current DBViewWrapper limits compaction handling to its displayed folder, saves view flags, lets the listener save selection, dissociates the search, closes the view and clears it. Completion refreshes the view. The 2005 landing removed the idea that stable keys make this teardown unnecessary. Database replacement and stable message identity are separate concerns; the current folder guard is newer than the assigned change. This is static source and test-code inspection at the frozen accepted revision. No runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check ran. Full Bugzilla and Phabricator timeline and inline discussion remain pending; a landing does not prove approval of a proposed manual rule.
title: Compaction rebuilds the displayed database view even when message keys are stable
